basis: ESTIMATES. No recorded per-child active time or token totals exist for a comparable macro (Pulse recorded neither; its commits span 2026-10-21 14:10 to 22:18 PDT with operator waits and a session restart between, so elapsed is not calibratable). Sized from deliverable scope: W01 is a streaming hook plus fs rewrite plus schema plus tests; W02 extends it in place; W03 is a short doc. Treat every number as a cap to be revised after the first measured run, by an amended revision.

recordable_measures.elapsed: coordinator wall clock at dispatch and at return
recordable_measures.advisor_calls: structural count of advisor tool_use/server_tool_use blocks in the child's transcript
not_recordable: coordinator's own tokens and active time (UNKNOWN, not budgeted)

on_limit: When ANY limit is reached or about to be exceeded: stop the running child at the next safe point (TaskStop; never mid-commit), dispatch nothing further, retry nothing, substitute nothing, leave the child's edits uncommitted, and report status NEEDS_SUPERVISOR with the allowance, the measured value, the cap and the files touched. A cap changes only by an amended package revision with new hashes and a new operator AUTHORIZE line.
enforcement: Coordinator discipline only. Neither macro_packet.v2 nor execution_binding.v2 has a field for allowances and `ct validate-macro` does not check them (UNKNOWN whether any other tool does). The numbers are pinned through each child's I09 invariant and the macro's global_stop_conditions text, and ALLOWANCES.json is pinned by sha256 in the macro's base_policy.
closure: At close the coordinator writes ALLOWANCE_LEDGER.json (measured vs cap, per child and macro) into the flat review_bundle; no value is invented.
